acceptance_threshold_origin: Project screening requirements frozen before this campaign; not industry standards or fitted to new results.

development.coupled_selection: Measured peak-efficiency reading on every transcribed speed line; additionally minimum/maximum measured flow on Stage 35's speed lines.
development.clearance_selection: Common measured-flow interval midpoint at 70 and 100 percent speed; linearly interpolate observations only inside overlap, no extrapolation.

holdout_policy: Do not relabel previously inspected Lewis data as independent holdout. Unavailable executable cases or measured maps are coverage failures, not passing validations.

geometry_projection.rule: Insert original interpolated hub/shroud radii at each blade edge, remove only contour stations strictly inside blade rows, retain all duct vertices.
geometry_projection.reason: Research approximation of geometries rejected by the single-gap model; never silently substituted for an exact machine or used to open the score.

uncertainty.anchor: nasa_stage35, measured peak efficiency at design speed
uncertainty.inlet_profile: Measured-state row tests and uniform-vs-measured inlet sensitivity; no unsupported claim about arbitrary public-contract inlet profiles.
uncertainty.measurement: Report stated sensor bounds individually; missing covariance and translated rotor-exit states prohibit interpreting sensitivity bands as confidence intervals.

design_sensitivity.interpretation: Repeatable local response, not experimental validation of a derivative without matched altered hardware.

decision: No validated operating envelope unless admission, numerical resolution, absolute error, spread, profiles, response, uncertainty and independent-holdout gates all pass. Component-only or transformed-input agreement is labelled diagnostic. Keep score disabled.
